She has been on routine surveillance with no evidence of disease until a recent whole‑body ¹⁸F‑FDG PET/CT performed 3 weeks ago, which demonstrated: * A new 2.5 cm hypermetabolic lesion in the left lower lobe (SUV ≈ 7.8). * An FDG‑avid mediastinal lymph node measuring 1.2 cm (SUV ≈ 5.4). * Multiple subcentimeter hepatic lesions with increased uptake (SUV ≈ 4–5). She denies new cough, hemoptysis, chest pain, or neurologic symptoms. She reports mild exertional dyspnea (NYHA class II) and intermittent fatigue, which she attributes to the recent imaging work‑up. Her ECOG performance status remains 2. No brain MRI has been obtained to date.
